notes.title: Addition of single mode scenario "ACCOLADE".
notes.notes:
[b]We are pleased to announce a major update to Xpraize.[/b]
Since we published the beta version, we have received a lot of feedback from our users about their confusion about the operation method.
In this update, we have implemented a scenario called "ACCOLADE," which can be considered a tutorial, so that you can first enjoy this Xpraize worldview.


This one is not intended to be played multiplayer, but can be played by a single player.
We think you will enjoy it alone, including magic chanting by voice recognition.
Even though it is a tutorial, it is full of content such as battles with knights and additional stages with action elements.

There are also some minor updates to the existing scenario, Dragon Descendants.
There are still many things we would like to add and brush up on, but we hope you enjoy this update first.

In the future, we plan to add a new scenario that will allow GMs to create dungeons in variable ways and share them with players, so we would be very happy if you would continue to support us.

We look forward to your valuable feedback.

notes.title: Update on July 25
notes.notes:
[h1]VR Update Contents[/h1]

[olist]
[h3][*]Addition of options screen[/h3]
Created a "Volume Adjustment" function to adjust the volume, a "Height Adjustment" function to adjust the height of the character, and an "Exit" function to log out of the room.
[h3][*]Creation of Status Screen[/h3]
Until now, you could only see your own status in HP or MP, but we added a function to allow you to check your status at any time in the game.
[h3][*]Improved operability[/h3]
Previously, the character's orientation was linked to the player's orientation.
However, we realized that when playing indoors, some people are in an environment where they cannot actually look around.
Therefore, we made it possible to control the viewpoint from the controller.
[/olist]


[h1]Common updates for PC & VR versions[/h1]

[olist]
[h3][*] Improvements around combat[/h3]
Various improvements have been made, such as giving NPCs weapon attack detection only when attacking, and playing sounds depending on the weapon when NPCs attack.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update on June 17, 2022
notes.notes:
[b]This update is mainly for the VR version, but the PC version also includes minor adjustments.[/b]

1. Added a function to adjust the position of the character using a mirror when selecting the character at the beginning of the game
2. Adjusted the display position of various UI.
3. Fixed a bug that prevented the ED from playing.
Fixed a synchronization bug when other players joined in the middle of the game.
